parts.name: Root
parts.description: The tabs container. Holds the selected value and provides context to the list, tabs, indicator, and panels.

props.name: keyboardActivation
props.description: 'automatic' activates tabs as arrow keys move focus; 'manual' waits for Enter or Space.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout axis of the tab list; also switches the arrow-key navigation axis.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the whole tabs group.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab value. Bindable. Pass null for no active tab.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected tab value when uncontrolled. Pass null when no tab should start active.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Values of tabs that cannot be focused or activated.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selected tab changes.

props.name: children
props.description: The list and panel parts.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the root element and used to derive tab and panel ids. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered root element.

props.name: context
props.description: Bindable handle exposing the tabs state (selected and focused values, orientation, activation helpers) for advanced composition.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole tabs group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The configured orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical').

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root element.

parts.name: List
parts.description: The tab strip. Renders role="tablist" and manages roving focus between tabs.

props.name: children
props.description: The tab and indicator parts.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered list element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole tabs group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The configured orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical').

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-list
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the list element.

parts.name: Tab
parts.description: A single tab button. Renders role="tab" with aria-selected and aria-controls pointing at its panel.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique value linking this tab to the panel with the same value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents this tab from being focused or activated.

props.name: children
props.description: The tab label content.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: Direction the selection moved from the previously active tab ('left' | 'right' | 'up' | 'down').

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tab is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the tab has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The configured orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical').

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the tab is the active tab.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-tab
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the tab element.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-value
dataAttributes.description: The tab's value, stringified.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the tab's value ('string' | 'number').

parts.name: Indicator
parts.description: An optional visual marker for the active tab. Measures the active tab and exposes its position and size through the --active-tab-left/top/width/height CSS variables.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional content rendered inside the indicator.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered span element.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: Direction the selection moved from the previously active tab ('left' | 'right' | 'up' | 'down').

dataAttributes.name: data-hidden
dataAttributes.description: Present when no tab is active.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The configured orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical').

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

parts.name: Panel
parts.description: The content associated with a tab. Renders role="tabpanel" with aria-labelledby, and is hidden while its tab is inactive.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of the tab this panel belongs to.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep the inactive panel mounted (hidden) instead of unmounting it, preserving its DOM state.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel content.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-hidden
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel's tab is inactive and the panel is hidden.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel's tab is active.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-panel
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-value
dataAttributes.description: The panel's value, stringified.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the panel's value ('string' | 'number').
